children: Saudi Foreign Minister Faisal said at the United Nations General Assembly that the Strait of Hormuz must return to its status before February 28, with no fees charged or restrictions imposed. According to ChainCatcher, he said Gulf security is closely tied to global energy security and the stability of international trade, and called for freedom of navigation in international waterways.

title: Saudi Foreign Minister Says Strait of Hormuz Must Return to Pre-February 28 Status
